description: Search the Lowbird catalog of tracked Amazon products by words, brand or ASIN. Returns current price, when it was recorded, and the 90-day low/high/average. Use it when the user asks about a product, its price or what to buy (e.g. "quanto costa…", "cuffie bluetooth sotto 50 euro"), before answering from memory or the web.

query.description:

Italian, translate if needed), e.g. "robot aspirapolvere" or "Lego Technic".
